meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 它会安装 OneCLI 与 Agent Vault 网关,把 .env 里已有的 Anthropic 凭据迁移进 vault 并从 .env 删除,再重建、重启服务,最后查日志确认网关配置生效。
howto.when: 在 /update-nanoclaw 引入 OneCLI 破坏性变更之后,或首次从零设置 OneCLI 时接管;若代码库还没集成 @onecli-sh/sdk,会让你先跑 /update-nanoclaw。

say.text: 帮我初始化 OneCLI,把 .env 里的凭据迁进 vault
say.note: 先检测环境,再安装网关与 CLI 并迁移凭据

say.text: 检查一下 OneCLI 是否已装好并配了 Anthropic 凭据
say.note: 已配置则问你保留还是重新配置

say.text: 把 OPENAI_API_KEY 也迁到 OneCLI vault 里
say.note: 会先征求你确认,再迁移并从 .env 移除

howto.what_en: Installs OneCLI and configures the Agent Vault gateway, migrates existing .env credentials into the vault, deletes the migrated lines from .env, then rebuilds and restarts the service and checks logs to confirm the gateway config applied.
howto.when_en: Run after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup. If @onecli-sh/sdk is missing from the codebase, it tells you to run /update-nanoclaw first.

say_en.text: Initialize OneCLI and migrate my .env credentials into the vault
say_en.note: Checks the environment, then installs and migrates

say_en.text: Check whether OneCLI is installed with an Anthropic secret
say_en.note: If configured, it asks keep or reconfigure

say_en.text: Also move OPENAI_API_KEY into the OneCLI vault
say_en.note: It confirms first, then migrates and edits .env
